scripts.build: npm run build:agent-rpc && npm -w @grepmind/agent run build && npm -w @grepmind/mcp run build && npm run build:deployment && npm run build:grepmind
scripts.build:agent: npm run build:agent-rpc && npm -w @grepmind/agent run build
scripts.build:mcp: npm run build:agent-rpc && npm -w @grepmind/mcp run build
scripts.pack:dry-run: npm -w @grepmind/agent-rpc pack --dry-run && npm -w @grepmind/agent pack --dry-run && npm -w @grepmind/mcp pack --dry-run && npm -w @grepmind/deployment pack --dry-run && npm -w grepmind pack --dry-run
scripts.release:stable: npm run build && npm run pack:dry-run && node tools/assert-stable-release.mjs && changeset publish --tag latest
scripts.release:beta: npm run build && npm run pack:dry-run && node tools/assert-beta-release.mjs && changeset publish --tag beta
scripts.lint: npm --workspaces run lint --if-present && npm run format:check
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:agent-rpc && npm -w @grepmind/agent run typecheck && npm -w @grepmind/mcp run typecheck && npm run typecheck:grepmind
scripts.typecheck:agent: npm run typecheck:agent-rpc && npm -w @grepmind/agent run typecheck
scripts.typecheck:mcp: npm run typecheck:agent-rpc && npm -w @grepmind/mcp run typecheck
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck
